rule: Evidence table only. A row is VERIFIED only with a satellite visual match from licensed imagery of known date and MEDIUM/HIGH confidence. plan_block_confidence says how sure the label-to-block reading is on the 2020 plan; it says nothing about the real campus. Backend records are never renamed or created from this table.
backend_inspection: The repository seed creates no Building rows (only door labels 'Building A' and 'Building B', placeholders). The real database was not inspected, so a backend match is unknown, not absent. Matching must be by exact Building.name supplied by the owner; no name is guessed.
